data.body: Implementation pushed: Gerrit change 2149 (commit c5297f808c0d, Change-Id I3a4a8406fa707eec4e9116660ff6c611b3c2bab9). drain() restructured into _collect_claims (under the drain lock: concurrency guard capped at 3 distinct live-lease drainers, self-heal re-enqueues, pending scan, optimistic claims + content-hash snapshots) -> _enrich_claims (LLM calls, NO lock) -> _finalize_claims (revalidate snapshot; stale -> skip emit + re-enqueue soak 0 as stale_skipped; else digest emit + DONE; failure dispositions unchanged). DEFAULT_OVERLAP_DRAIN_BATCH 5 -> 20 with a lease-derived clamp lease_ttl_s // 40 (= 22 at the default 15-min lease). New counted (not timed) pins in tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py: lock-probe runner acquires the drain lock from inside every run() call (RED against the old shape: 0/3 acquisitions; GREEN now: 3/3); re-entrant runner overlaps two drains on 10 tickets -> exactly 10 LLM calls, all tickets DONE (zero duplicate spend); stale-writeback revalidation; lease-expiry recovery; concurrency-cap skip at 3 live drainers / admit at 2; batch clamp (env 1000 -> effective 22, default 20). make lint (incl. complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0, module 574 LOC < 800) + make typecheck + 97 unit tests + the two-clone integration drain test all pass. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1.
